title: Middleton announces fall yard waste collection schedule and guidelines
text:

Middleton | wikipedia.org
Leaf collection in the City of Middleton will begin in mid-October and continue into November, depending on weather conditions. Crews are scheduled to make regular rounds for leaf pickup until the first snowfall or by November 30. Residents are reminded to place leaves in loose piles at the curb, without using bags, containers, or tarps.
The city’s brush pickup service will end for the year on October 31, 2025. Brush must be less than six inches in diameter and should be stacked parallel to the curb with cut ends facing the same direction. The city emphasizes that leaves and brush should not be mixed, as they are collected separately.
Residents looking for additional disposal options can bring yard materials to the MRD Compost Facility in Waunakee. This service is free for Middleton residents.
Further information about yard waste guidelines and drop-off rules can be found on the City of Middleton Public Works Services page at cityofmiddleton.us/359/Services.
